C (negative control for the PR body's E2E section): `legion start` against a legion.yaml with `instructions: ./missing.md` must exit non-zero with `[legion] instructions file <abs path> could not be read` and leave no `<state_dir>/state.json` or `deployment-instructions.md`; `daemon.lock` may exist. defaultDependencies requires dispatch_url + DISPATCH_TOKEN before anything else runs; nats_urls may be unreachable. Then with a real file, `<state_dir>/deployment-instructions.md` appears with the header `# Deployment instructions (<project as written>)` before the OMP probes run.
